scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "DB,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:db --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
